summary: Frontend-only test of the mobile viewport fit fix on /inicio.html using real Playwright device emulation (iPhone 13 and Pixel 5). Also regression-tested desktop (1920x800) and quickly checked /pagamento-pix.html and /inscricao-realizada.html on mobile.

iphone_13_inicio.hero_text_found: INSCRIÇÕES PRORROGADAS. NOVA DATA DE PROVA.

critical_code_review_comments: The mobile-viewport-fit script only listens to 'orientationchange' but not to 'resize'. If a user rotates from portrait->landscape, orientationchange fires; but not all browsers fire it reliably on modern devices. Adding a 'resize' listener (debounced) would make the fix more robust. Not blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The mobile viewport fit fix on /inicio.html works as expected on real device emulation (iPhone 13, Pixel 5): meta rewritten to width=1300 initial-scale≈0.3, hero 'INSCRIÇÕES...' fully visible (right edge 1246 < 1300), no horizontal scroll, and desktop remains unchanged. The other pages (pagamento-pix, inscricao-realizada) use responsive layout and were fine.
rca of the issue: Not applicable - fix verified working. Original bug was that /inicio.html is a fixed-width desktop layout (~1300-1524px) so on mobile the hero was clipped and horizontal scroll appeared. The injected script now, on width<1000px, sets meta viewport to width=1300 with initial-scale=innerWidth/1300 causing the browser to zoom out and show the entire page fitted to screen width.
